verdict.rationale: Fireworks docs explicitly describe a sticky-routing/session-affinity header that 'pins repeated requests to the same replica to maximize prompt-cache hit rate,' directly supporting reduced latency/cost on repeated context. However, there is no dedicated caching documentation (e.g., cache pricing, cache-hit metrics, or independent benchmarks confirming latency/cost reduction). Missing for 10: dedicated prompt-caching docs with cost/latency benchmarks, independent/hands-on corroboration of cache-hit savings.
